fields.summary_ko.0: Micron (NASDAQ: MU) transitioning from cyclical to stable business model through multi-year contracts locking in 35% of revenue through 2030, similar structure to logic chipmakers like TSMC.
fields.summary_ko.1: Forward P/E 5.1x versus TSMC's 24x indicates severe undervaluation; significant stock re-rating possible once market recognizes business model shift.
